title: cirsium esculentum
intro: Cirsium esculentum, commonly known as the artichoke thistle or artichoke, is a perennial plant native to Europe and Asia. It is a rich source of antioxidants, flavonoids, and saponins, which provide various health benefits such as lowering cholesterol levels, improving digestion, and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Cirsium esculentum include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and hepatoprotective effects, which may help protect against oxidative stress and liver damage. The bioactive constituents of this plant include cynarin, silymarin, and caffeic acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
